messages:
anya: Idea: show an "Estimated units" pill on Embed Route pages so users can see if a request will overflow before sending.  

phil: We already return estimates in opt-in preflight (`X-Embed-Preflight`). We can surface `est_units`, `est_confidence`, and a short `split_summary_label` to Console. Example internal preflight body: { "est_units": 14, "est_confidence": "medium", "split_summary_label": "3 chunks (2x768,1x512)" }.  

maria: UX: show "~14 units · medium confidence · may split into 3 chunks" with tooltip and one-click "Show fix" that opens SDK snippet. No raw JSON in UI.  

jamie: Perf note: estimator currently scans full payload. For Console, do a sample-first heuristic (N=3). If sample variance high, return low confidence and schedule background profiling.  

phil: We'll add `est_confidence` (low/med/high). For mixed dims add client hint `X-Embed-Dims` to let SDKs pre-declare shapes.  

anya: Privacy: make preflight opt-out per-tenant. Console toggle "Enable preflight estimates" with audit events.  

maria: Telemetry: emit `embed.preflight.estimated_units` and `embed.preflight.prediction_error` (tags: route, env, confidence). Avoid high-cardinality tenant ids.  

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: test vectors uploaded to staging at /staging/embed-testvectors.  

jamie: Rollout: dark launch to 5%, collect predicted vs actual unit p50/p90 error. Auto-rollback if median error > 20% for 1h or 413 regressions increase. I'll own rollback playbook.  

phil: Observability: dashboard predicted vs actual units + oversize 413 rate. Internal only: raw `split_summary`. UI gets friendly label. Alert: if per-route 413 rate > 0.5% AND predicted_units drop >30% then page eng-platform.  

anya: I'll mock the pill + help modal (includes SDK snippet for client-side chunking). Will post mock by EOD.  

maria: Owners: @jamie rollout, @phil telemetry, @maria UI, @anya console mock. Sync tomorrow 10am to review metrics.
